longDescription:
Brave is a Chromium-based web browser focused on privacy and performance. Brave Shields blocks many ads, trackers, fingerprinting techniques, and other unwanted content by default while retaining compatibility with Chromium extensions.

The stable release channel is installed from Brave Software's official APT repository.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export LC_ALL=C
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

fail() {
    printf '%s: %s\n' 'brave-browser' "$*" >&2
    exit 1
}

ARCH="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"
[ "$ARCH" = amd64 ] || fail "unsupported architecture: $ARCH"

if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ ! -s /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt ]; then
    apt-get update
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl
fi

install -d -m 0755 /usr/share/keyrings /etc/apt/sources.list.d
curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 -o '/usr/share/keyrings/brave-browser-archive-keyring.gpg' 'https://brave-browser-apt-release.s3.brave.com/brave-browser-archive-keyring.gpg'
chmod 0644 '/usr/share/keyrings/brave-browser-archive-keyring.gpg'

cat >'/etc/apt/sources.list.d/brave-browser.sources' <<'EOF'
Types: deb
URIs: https://brave-browser-apt-release.s3.brave.com
Suites: stable
Components: main
Architectures: amd64
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/brave-browser-archive-keyring.gpg
EOF
chmod 0644 '/etc/apt/sources.list.d/brave-browser.sources'

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends 'brave-browser'
dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}\n' 'brave-browser' | grep -Fqx 'install ok installed' || fail 'package installation was not recorded by dpkg'

apt-get clean
